payload.title: Calculating Global Coherence
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate the significance and sensitivity of global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotopes from marine sediment records. It defines functions to compute maximum global coherence within a specified period band and assesses significance using AR1 surrogates. The notebook also utilizes the Climlab library to define insolation curves and calculates correlations to identify the most correlated latitude of insolation. The results are visualized through plots.
goals: Calculate global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotopes.
Assess the significance and sensitivity of global coherence.
Identify the most correlated latitude of insolation.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook outlines the process of using Pyleoclim to calculate global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotopes, focusing on significance and sensitivity testing. It includes defining necessary functions, loading data, and performing correlation analysis to identify the most correlated latitude of insolation.
